sources.label: A collection of font-related Morphe patches to improve readability/accessibility
sources.author: Stylus
patch_list: Custom font
Replaces the bundled Inter and Mona Sans UI fonts with your own font.
Custom monospace font
Replaces the bundled Roboto Mono code font with your own monospace font.
Force system font
Uses the device's system font for UI text.
Force system font (including monospace)
Uses the device's system font for UI and monospace text.

sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Add collapsible section
Adds a button to the markdown toolbars that puts a collapsible <details> section around the selected text.
Add download menu to every file
Adds Download to the menu of an open file, which saves it with the system download manager.
Add Preview menu to HTML files
Adds Preview to the menu of an HTML file, which shows the page with the repository's styles and images. Scripts stay off until you allow them.
Add table
Adds a button to the markdown toolbars that inserts a markdown table template around the selected text.
Collapse bot and agent comments
Comments by bots and agents such as Copilot start collapsed. Descriptions stay open.
Conventional commits
Titles of commits, issues, pull requests and notifications such as feat(auth): add login show their type as a colored pill.
Dim bots and agents
Commits, issues and pull requests by bots and agents such as Copilot are faded in their lists, and so are the events they add to timelines.
Disable analytics
Turns off analytics, telemetry and crash reporting.
Download assets natively
Downloads release assets directly with the system download manager instead of opening the browser.
Draw Mermaid diagrams
Draws Mermaid diagrams in place of their code. Tap a diagram to open it full screen and pinch to zoom.
Fold long code blocks
Folds code blocks longer than 25 lines to their first 20, with a button that shows all of them.
Hide + and - diff signs
Hides the + and - signs on diff lines since additions and deletions are already color coded.
Hide Copilot disclaimer
Removes the line under Copilot's comments that says it is powered by AI and can make mistakes.
Hide low-quality comments
Hides issue and pull request comments that only say +1, me too or ask for news.
Hide navigation bar labels
Hides the text under the icons of the navigation bar.
Home header text
Shows your username or display name in the Home header instead of Home.
Icon-only Add to list button
Shows the Add to list button of a repository without its text, as small as the icon buttons beside it.
Icon-only floating buttons
Shows floating buttons, such as Comment, Re-run and Commit changes, without their text.
Landscape navigation bar position
Lets you put the navigation bar on the left or right edge in landscape.
Linkify code
Opens addresses and references such as owner/repo#123 in files, diffs and code blocks when tapped.
Linkify user location
Makes the location on a user profile open in Maps when tapped.
Liquid Glass navigation bar
Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. Can blur what's behind it.
Material You
Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+) in light and dark mode.
Navigation bar tabs
Lets you choose and sort the navigation bar tabs, and adds Repositories and Stars tabs.
Override tab width
Shows tabs in files, diffs and code blocks as 2, 4 or 8 spaces wide. The app uses 8.
Pin important branches
Lists develop, main, master and staging right after the default branch in the branch picker.
Pin recent branches
Lists the most recently pushed branches near the top of the branch picker, with how long ago.
Pitch black
Turns the dark mode backgrounds black (Android 12+).
Preview hidden comments
Shows the start of a hidden comment under the reason it is hidden.
Shorten GitHub links
Shows pasted links in comments and READMEs as short references, such as owner/repo#123.
Show avatar before each @mention
Shows a small avatar before each @mention in comments, descriptions and READMEs.
Show base branch in pull requests
Shows the base branch in pull request lists when it is not the default branch.
Show download count for assets
Shows how many times each file of a release was downloaded, next to its size.
Show exact time
Shows dates and times instead of ages such as 20d, in lists, issues, pull requests and comments.
Show if a profile follows you
Shows on user profiles when that user follows you.
Show labels in the header
Shows the labels of an issue or pull request under its title, in a row you can swipe sideways.
Show repository age
Shows when a repository was created, under its stars and forks.
Show tags on commits
Displays git tags next to matching commits in commit lists.
Show whitespace marks
Shows spaces as dim dots and tabs as dim » marks in files and diffs. Copied lines stay as they are.
Smaller navigation bar
Shrinks the navigation bar height, icon-to-label spacing, and label text size.
Sort by Recently updated first
Sorts issue and pull request lists by Recently updated instead of Newest. Another sort you pick lasts until you leave the list.
